crossRefs.note: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked…
This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

translations.web: This was done three times, and immediately the vessel was received up into heaven.
translations.bsb: This happened three times, and all at once the sheet was taken back up into heaven.
translations.kjv: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
translations.asv: And this was done thrice: and straightway the vessel was received up into heaven.
